basic_info.description: Discover this stunning contemporary Victorian home nestled in the desirable Jordan Park/Laurel Heights neighborhood. With over 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, this residence features a modern, open floor plan designed for today's lifestyle. The beautifully renovated kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room, dining, and living areas, creating an inviting space perfect for gatherings. Elegant new wide plank flooring throughout enhances the home's sophisticated appeal.    Enjoy direct outdoor access from the living room or primary suite, leading to a serene, park-like garden on a spacious 27' x 120' lot. Mature trees provide privacy, tranquility, and plenty of space for family fun and entertaining. Technical upgrades include an EV charger in the spacious garage, a solar array on the newer (2021) roof, whole-home water filtration, a dual-zone heat pump (air conditioning), and newer washer, dryer, and stove.  Located just 1.5 blocks from Laurel Village's charming cafes, shops, and markets, with additional access to the chic ambiance of Sacramento Street, this home offers unbeatable convenience with a 94 Walk Score. Experience the perfect blend of modern comfort and timeless charm in this exceptional property.
